newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Energy stocks said cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Energy stocks said cut.

text.p: -- Smith Barney cut energy stocks to underweight from overweight, a market source said.
-- The source said Smith Barney cut Anadarko Petroleum Corp and Vintage Petroleum Inc to neutral from buy.
It cut Apache Corp to outperform from buy
Devon Energy Corp to neutral from outperform
Enron Oil & Gas Co to outperform from buy
Enserch Exploration Inc to outperform from buy
Louisiana Land and Exploration Co to neutral from outperform
Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co to neutral from outperform
Plains Resources Inc to neutral from outperform
Texas Meridian Resources Corp to neutral from outperform and
Union Texas Petroleum to neutral from outperform.
-- The analyst was not immediately available for comment.
